outcome: Percentage of women receiving opioid prescriptions
cohort: The study participants were women being discharged from one medical center following childbirth.
finding: Following an academic detailing intervention, the overall percentage of women who received opioid prescriptions and the average prescription size decreased among women discharged after childbirth.
mod_finding: The percentage of women receiving opioid prescriptions decreased for both cesarean sections (from 100% to 93%) and vaginal deliveries (from 15% to 9%) after the intervention.
